The target template is maintained at
https://github.com/regionstockholm/CKM-mirror-via-modellbibliotek/blob/Obstetrix-openEHR/MHV1-%20Prenatal%20visit.encounter.v1.t.json

The Example Set `obx-mhv1-unmapped-json-to-openehr` loads that GitHub `.t.json`
URL so dependent archetypes are fetched from the same branch. Do not load the
differential `.t.json` as a lone file.
